verdicts.question: What type of roof is present at the site?
verdicts.photo_observation: Pages 12-15 show a flat, plain concrete-finish terrace with parapet walls, headroom and water tanks; no tiles or sheets.
verdicts.rationale: Flat terrace consistent with RCC flat roof.

verdicts.question: Are there any obstructions on the roof that could affect the solar installation?
verdicts.photo_observation: Page 14-15 photos show two water tanks, an outdoor AC unit and a headroom structure on/near the terrace; 3D model (pp5-7) places the array adjacent to the tanks.
verdicts.rationale: Tanks/AC/headroom exist near the array; reviewer should confirm they are not treated as obstructions or shading sources.

verdicts.question: What is the angle of the panels? (in degrees)
verdicts.photo_observation: Only 3D renders (pp5-7) of an elevated array with low tilt; no site photo allows measuring the angle.
verdicts.rationale: Tilt cannot be verified visually from renders.

verdicts.question: On how many roofs at the site are we installing solar?
verdicts.photo_observation: Single upper terrace above the headroom hosts the array (pp5-8, 14); lower terrace used only for material storage (p13).

verdicts.question: What type of mounting structure is planned?

verdicts.photo_observation: 3D renders (pp5-7) show an elevated table structure with 2.00 m front leg and 2 rows of portrait modules.
verdicts.rationale: Renders match elevated 2 m leg, 2-row portrait description.

verdicts.question: What is the orientation of the solar panels?

verdicts.question: How can the roof be accessed?
verdicts.designer_notes: The upper headroom can be accessed via a metal staircase provided.

verdicts.question: Is the site photo matching with the building description?

verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target
verdicts.photo_observation: Pages 14-17 show coloured DC/AC/earth/LA lines from array along parapet, down the building side wall to the car porch DCDB/ACDB/inverter, then to solar and main meter (p17); lines consistent in colour with no orphan ends, but physical conduit/clipping not visible since routes are overlays.
